messages:
Sophie: FYI customer 'Helios GmbH' escalated — their AP is rejecting payments. Says invoice doesn't show VAT per local entity and amounts don't match PO. PO# 900123-EMEA.
Liam: ugh. do we have the invoice they received?
Sophie: attached PDF from customer — they highlighted two things: invoice in EUR from our EU entity but AP needs local-currency (CHF) invoice + VAT split by Swiss entity. also our gross total differs from PO by CHF 0.03 due to FX rounding.
Maya: can you paste the invoice payload we sent to the aggregator? might be a currency normalization bug.
Sophie: billing-bot already posted the generated payload at time of invoice:
billing-bot: {"invoice_id":"INV-2026-0047","entity_id":"redwood-eu","currency":"EUR","net":1200.00,"vat":240.00,"gross":1440.00}
Adam: looks like billing-bot normalized to EUR even though the customer's billing profile requested CHF. where does currency selection happen — checkout?
Liam: checkout uses customer.billing_currency pref -> falls back to entity default. For this account customer.billing_currency=CHF, but entity mapping might be wrong for multi-entity accounts.
Eli: customer says their AP system validates PO total against invoice gross in local currency. Because we issued EUR invoice, their FX conversion (bank rate) yields gross mismatch by a few cents and their system rejects it.
Maya: repro steps I ran: 1) Create test acct with billing_currency=CHF and linked entity redwood-eu and redwood-ch 2) generate invoice via /admin/invoices 3) observe payload currency=EUR 4) conversion applied later in PDF render pipeline -> rounding happened at line-level instead of total -> 0.03 discrepancy.
Liam: thanks. sounds like two issues: wrong entity/currency selection for invoice creation, and inconsistent rounding (line vs total). both cause PO matching failures.
Sophie: customer demands local-currency invoice from the Swiss entity (redwood-ch) with VAT breakdown and the PO number visible on header. They also asked for a corrected invoice for last month.
Adam: quick mitigation: we can reissue a manual invoice from redwood-ch in CHF and mark original as replaced. Need approval for JV accounting adjustments.
Maya: patch idea: ensure invoice creation reads billing_currency from billing_profile and picks entity by currency override if customer has multi-entity enabled. Also change rounding to use "total-first" algorithm (sum net/vat then round) to match AP expectations.
Liam: agree. we should also add explicit fields in invoice JSON: "currency_code","entity_id","line_rounding_policy" so downstream AP/ERP can validate deterministically.
Eli: customer needs ETA. can we do manual reissue today?
Adam: I can reissue once finance signs off. need quick GL mapping for redwood-ch. Sophie — can you confirm VAT id and billing address to use?
Sophie: provided by customer in thread: UID CHE-12345678, VAT rate 7.7%, billing address CH-8001 Zurich.
Maya: dev plan: hotfix to invoice service to prefer billing_profile.currency -> entity override lookup -> then set payload.currency before any rendering. also change PDF renderer to calculate totals from unrounded net/vat then round final total. I'll open a PR and tag @liam for review.
Liam: estimate 3-4 hrs for hotfix + 1hr for QA. After deploy we can re-generate corrected invoice.
Eli: customer asked for credit note for original or replaced invoice. they want to show replacement and credit in same AP run.
Adam: we will issue a credit note from redwood-eu for the erroneous invoice and create new CHF invoice from redwood-ch. I'll prepare docs for accounting.
Sophie: can we also include a short note on invoices explaining rounding differences and exchange rate used? that helps AP teams.
Maya: yes. we can add a footer: "Exchange rate used and rounding policy: line items rounded to 2 decimals; totals computed by summing unrounded values and rounding final total." or use the deterministic policy per earlier.
billing-bot: action logged: ticket FIN-4821 created, assigned to Adam + Maya, priority: P1-Customer Payment Blocker.
Liam: one more request — add machine-readable fields so customer's ERPs can auto-accept (e.g., original_amount_currency, original_amount, exchange_rate). I'll add to schema change.
Eli: customer confirmed they're OK with reissue + credit note if done today. please keep them in loop.
Sophie: I'll notify customer after we reissue. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
